user_query: I'm planning a family vacation and I need to get the vaccination guidelines for traveling.

TaskList.description: Identify the countries the family plans to visit for vacation.
Gather vaccination guidelines for each of the identified countries.
Compile a list of vaccinations required for each country, including specific requirements.
Find healthcare mailing lists or contact information for medical professionals and clinics in each country.
Reach out to the identified medical professionals and clinics for additional information.
